problems.phrase: Southern Cornbread is a hearty, unsweetened variety of cornbread, widely served in the Southeastern United States.

Ingredients

2 cups yellow or white self-rising corn meal

1 large egg

1¼–1½ cups buttermilk or whole milk

¼ cup olive
If using cast-iron skillet, place it in the oven to heat.
If using non-cast-iron skillet or baking pan, coat with a non-stick spray.
Stir in the cornmeal and mix until just moistened.
The batter will be somewhat lumpy.
For an 8-inch skillet this can be 25–30 minutes; for a 10-inch skillet or an 8x8-inch baking pan about 20–25 minutes.
Allow to cool for 5 minutes in pan before serving.

Notes, tips, and variations

It can be frozen in storage bags for several months, but will usually become more crumbly if stored this way.
